title: ChatGPT Major Update: Free Users Upgrade to GPT-5.6 Luna and Get Unlimited Chat Access; Paid Users Receive Thought Depth Adjustment

content_html:
OpenAI announced a comprehensive update to ChatGPT, bringing significant feature improvements for both free and paid users. The default model for free and Go users has been upgraded to GPT-5.6 Luna. Starting next week, the official will fully open unlimited text chat permissions, eliminating the previous issue of free users frequently hitting usage limits. For complex questions requiring in-depth thinking, users can now call higher-level reasoning capabilities at any time using the new "Think" button. This feature is subject to anti-abuse security measures to prevent misuse, and existing restrictions on file uploads and image generation still apply.

For Plus and Pro paying users, OpenAI updated the GPT-5.6 Sol model in the chat interface, making its responses more factually accurate and more focused. The newly added slider feature is particularly eye-catching, allowing users to freely adjust the depth of thinking that ChatGPT uses when generating each response, enabling a flexible switch between quick answers and deep reasoning. Since this version of GPT-5.6 Sol is specifically optimized for everyday conversations, it will only be available in the regular ChatGPT conversation interface and will not affect the GPT-5.6 Sol version that drives Work and Codex functions.

Layered Strategy Covers All User Groups

This update reflects OpenAI's refined layered product strategy. Free users have received a stronger default model and unlimited text chat capabilities, lowering the barrier to AI use and helping to continuously expand the user base and resist the impact of competitors' free strategies. Paid users, on the other hand, get more accurate answers and adjustable thinking depth, meeting different scenario needs from daily Q&A to complex reasoning, further strengthening the value proposition of paid subscriptions.

The introduction of the "Think" button means free users can now call advanced reasoning capabilities on demand, rather than always using a lower-tier model, breaking the previous simple model hierarchy between free and paid users. The slider adjusting the depth of thinking gives users active control over the AI's response method, allowing them to make their own trade-offs between speed and depth. With GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol running in parallel, OpenAI is trying to cover the full spectrum of needs from light users to heavy developers with a more flexible product form, reinforcing user loyalty in competition with Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 宣布对 ChatGPT 进行全面更新，为免费和付费用户带来重大功能改进。 免费和Go用户的默认模型已升级到GPT-5.6 Luna。 下周开始，官方将全面开放无限制文字聊天权限，消除此前免费用户频繁触及使用上限的问题。 对于需要深入思考的复杂问题，用户现在可以使用新的“思考”按钮随时调用更高级别的推理功能。 此功能受到反滥用安全措施的约束，以防止滥用，并且对文件上传和图像生成的现有限制仍然适用。

针对Plus和Pro付费用户，OpenAI在聊天界面更新了GPT-5.6 Sol模型，使其响应更真实、更针对性。 新增的滑块功能尤为引人注目，用户可以自由调整ChatGPT在生成每个响应时所使用的思维深度，从而实现快速回答和深度推理之间的灵活切换。 由于该版本的 GPT-5.6 Sol 专门针对日常对话进行了优化，因此它仅在常规 ChatGPT 对话界面中可用，并且不会影响驱动 Work 和 Codex 功能的 GPT-5.6 Sol 版本。

分层策略覆盖所有用户群体

此次更新体现了OpenAI精细化的分层产品策略。 免费用户获得了更强大的默认模式和无限制的文字聊天功能，降低了AI使用门槛，有助于不断扩大用户群，抵御竞争对手免费策略的影响。 另一方面，付费用户可以获得更准确的答案和可调的思维深度，满足从日常问答到复杂推理的不同场景需求，进一步强化付费订阅的价值主张。

“思考”按钮的引入意味着免费用户现在可以按需调用高级推理功能，而不是总是使用较低层的模型，打破了之前免费和付费用户之间简单的模型层次结构。 调整思维深度的滑块使用户能够主动控制人工智能的响应方法，使他们能够在速度和深度之间做出自己的权衡。 通过GPT-5.6 Luna和Sol并行运行，OpenAI试图以更灵活的产品形态覆盖从轻度用户到重度开发者的全方位需求，在与Google Gemini和Anthropic Claude的竞争中增强用户忠诚度。
